We covered infra constraints, expected concurrent sessions (~50), and some initial cost targets.

Next step: a 30-minute product intro to show the runtime, routing/fallback behavior, and how we measure cost/latency. Can you pick one of the three windows below (all times PT)? If none work, send a couple options and we’ll adapt.

- Tue Dec 1, 14:00–14:30 PT
- Wed Dec 2, 09:00–09:30 PT
- Thu Dec 3, 10:30–11:00 PT
